scripts.dev:all: docker compose up -d && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "PHP,VITE,QUEUE,REVERB" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold,green.bold" "PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS=4 php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000" "vite" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1 --timeout=0" "php artisan reverb:start --port=8085"
scripts.onlyoffice:start: docker compose up -d && docker exec dokuflow-onlyoffice sed -i 's/"allowPrivateIPAddress": false/"allowPrivateIPAddress": true/g' /etc/onlyoffice/documentserver/default.json && docker exec dokuflow-onlyoffice supervisorctl restart all
